experiment_scope: development; frozen Orca trajectories; not an online causal intervention

development_selection.rule: first 8 instance IDs in frozen baseline input order

extended_selection.rule: all instance IDs in the same frozen input order

native_final_k: number of unique nonempty normalized file paths in original bug_locations
candidate_order: first_seen_step ascending, then original frozen ledger row ordinal; no model confidence or new score
Original: Keep original final file order and original final locations exactly after path normalization and file deduplication.
PreserveAll: Retain all observed candidate-scope location records in memory, then project their existing first-appearance order to unique files up to original final K. PreserveAll refers to historical retention, not output expansion.
PreserveNonRefuted: Apply the same projection after excluding only exact location records whose pre-existing frozen classification is EXPLICITLY_REFUTED with a nonempty refutation_events list. Method or symbol refutation never refutes the file or another location record.
insufficient_eligible_fallback: Fill unoccupied slots in original final order to preserve exact native K; mark any forced refuted fallback explicitly. No search for replacement candidates.
k_zero: Keep final output empty, while reporting preserved memory candidates; do not expand native cardinality.
methods: Export only method names already present on selected observed location records; no method inference, disambiguation, signature synthesis, or line inference.
reference_isolation: The runner opens only the four frozen allowlisted baseline/ledger/classification/freeze-marker inputs and this policy file; it never loads reference, patch or evaluation files.
